top_signals.title: Stumbling Equity Rally Hinges on Earnings for Year-End Boost
top_signals.summary: Strong corporate earnings will be pivotal to hopes for a year-end rally in global stocks, as flare-ups in fears over inflation, bond volatility and artificial intelligence spending weigh on sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Copper Gains on Interest-Rate Outlook and Chile Mine Avalanche
top_signals.summary: Copper rose to a two-week high as traders looked to a more hopeful outlook for interest rates and gauged the impact on supply of a fatal mine incident in Chile.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
